{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravane station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Gravane system/Legends|Gravane system]]. It was the site of some fighting during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Morgra]] was exiled there and he opened a hotel, the [[Throne Room (Gravane station)|''Throne Room'']], on board the station.
